blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Color Series and Nation Paints pulled off impressive quarterfinal upsets to complete the semifinal cast of the Cebu Architects Basketball Club (CABC) 4th Boysen Cup Basketball Tournament on Sunday, November 22, at the Benedicto College Gymnasium. The sixth-seeded Color Series stunned third-seeded Konstrukt, 82-68. Fifth-seeded Nation Paints narrowly edged fourth-seeded Titan Superflex, 63-61. With these wins, Color Series and Nation Paints secured the remaining two semifinal berths in the season-ending conference of the CABC. Color Series leaned on a strong second-half performance to overcome a seven-point halftime deficit and eliminate Konstrukt.
